data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to read, create, update, and delete calendars and events on Android and iOS devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to request calendar permissions, list calendars, retrieve events, and manage events including attendees, reminders, and recurrence. Supports timezone-aware dates via the timezone package.
use_when: You need to interact with the native calendar on a user's device
You want to add or edit events programmatically in Android or iOS
avoid_when: You require cross‑platform calendar syncing with a backend service
You need advanced UI calendar widgets (use a UI‑kit instead)
strengths: Full read/write access to device calendars
weaknesses: Limited to device‑local data, no cloud sync
Potential issues with Swift plugins in Objective‑C projects
data.setup_notes: Add READ_CALENDAR and WRITE_CALENDAR permissions to AndroidManifest.xml; add NSCalendarsUsageDescription, NSContactsUsageDescription, and NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription keys to iOS Info.plist; optionally add ProGuard rule '-keep class com.builttoroam.devicecalendar.** { *; }'; import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' if using timezone features.
